# Substrate Systems — Full Content

> Substrate Systems OÜ is a solo-founded Estonian software company building durable systems infrastructure. The company operates under the brand "Substrate" at substratesystems.io. Founded by Hugo Ander Kivi.

---

## Company Overview

Substrate is a foundational systems company. Software infrastructure for durable systems. No lock-in; the website discloses aggregate analytics, while Endstate's local app has no telemetry.

### Philosophy

- Systems precede products.
- Constraints enable clarity.
- Foundations compound.
- Simplicity is not reduction.

---

## Endstate

**Tagline:** Save your machine. Set up the next one.

Endstate is a free, open-source desktop app for Windows that captures your installed applications and optionally their settings, saves everything to a portable file you control, and restores them on a fresh Windows install in minutes.

- The local product is free forever, on any number of machines, with no account and no telemetry.
- Uses winget for app installation.
- Provisioning engine is an open-source Go CLI (Apache 2.0): https://github.com/Artexis10/endstate
- Desktop GUI built with Tauri (React + Rust), also open source: https://github.com/Artexis10/endstate-gui
- Download: https://substratesystems.io/download

### How It Works

1. **Save:** Scan your current machine. Endstate detects every installed app and finds settings for supported apps. Everything gets saved to a single file.
2. **Set up:** Open your saved file on a fresh Windows install. Endstate shows what needs installing and what you already have. Choose whether to restore settings, then apply.

### Features

- **Automatic app detection:** Scans and finds every installed app — EXE/MSI and Microsoft Store. No manual lists.
- **Settings backup for 300+ apps:** Editors and IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim), terminals, creative tools (Blender, DaVinci Resolve, Ableton Live), media players, emulators, note-taking apps (Obsidian, Logseq), and many more. The list is open source and growing. Always opt-in, never automatic.
- **Portable setup files:** Stored as plain files in Documents. Copy, back up, share. No cloud account required.
- **User control:** Apps install one at a time with UAC prompts. Nothing installs silently. Stop at any point.
- **Preview mode:** Check machine state against a saved setup without changing anything.
- **Reversible:** Every settings restore creates a backup first. One-click revert.

### Validated Apps

48 apps are sandbox-validated for automated installation, including VS Code, Git, OBS Studio, Blender, Obsidian, Discord, KeePassXC, and more.

### System Requirements

- Windows (uses winget)
- Internet connection required for restoring apps (downloading installers)
- Scanning and saving works offline; the local product never phones home

### Pricing

- **Endstate local product: Free forever.** Any number of machines. No account, no license key, no telemetry.
- **Endstate Cloud (optional): €4/month or €40/year.** Managed encrypted backup, encrypted on your machine before it leaves. Local by default, cloud only by choice.
- **Support Endstate (optional, one-time).** Voluntary contributions towards development, currently €89 (Patron), with €10 (Supporter) and €29 (Founding Supporter) planned. Supporting unlocks no features, creates no entitlement, and carries no recurring obligation. Larger contributions are arranged by email as a Custom Project Sponsor.
- **Sponsor an integration: by quotation.** Funds deeper migration support for a specific application. No public fixed price.

### FAQ

**How much does Endstate cost?**
The local product is free forever on as many machines as you like. The one optional paid service is Endstate Cloud, encrypted managed backup at €4/month or €40/year. Supporting the project is separate, voluntary, and unlocks nothing.

**What types of apps does Endstate detect?**
Apps installed via traditional installers (EXE/MSI) and Microsoft Store. Uses winget under the hood. Portable apps not registered in Windows are not detected.

**Does it need admin rights?**
Scanning doesn't require admin. Restoring apps may need admin depending on what's being installed.

**Can I use it across multiple machines?**
Yes — the free local product runs on any number of machines.

**What if something goes wrong during restore?**
Endstate creates a backup before changing any settings. One-click revert. App installs use standard Windows installers, uninstallable normally.

**Is an internet connection required?**
Scanning and saving works offline. Restoring needs internet to download installers.

**Is this safe to run?**
The provisioning engine is open source — you can read exactly what it does before running anything.

## Exomem

**Tagline:** External memory for AI agents over a Markdown vault you own.

Exomem is an open-source, self-hosted MCP server that gives AI agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP client) durable long-term memory over your own Markdown / Obsidian vault. Your files stay plain markdown on your machine — no import into a proprietary store, no cloud dependency.

- Install: `pip install exomem` (PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/exomem/)
- Source (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem
- Product page: https://substratesystems.io/exomem

### Features

- **Hybrid retrieval, measured fast at scale:** keyword/BM25 lanes served by SQLite FTS5 indexes plus local vector search (sqlite-vec) fused with graph and reranking signals. Sub-second end-to-end search at 50,000 notes, measured; benchmark methodology is published in the repository (docs/benchmarks.md).
- **Multimodal indexing, fully local:** OCR (Tesseract), speech-to-text (faster-whisper), PDF and Office documents, and CLIP image search — text, screenshots, audio, and video become searchable.
- **Typed knowledge operations:** raw sources, compiled notes, entities, evidence, and supersession history live in typed folders; MCP tools cover search, capture, notes, evidence, audit, and review queues.
- **Human review loop:** audit and attention queues surface stale conclusions, unprocessed sources, broken links, and close-by claims for human review.
- **Measures, never judges:** the server does deterministic work (search, extraction, ranking, embeddings, file writes, graph checks); reasoning stays in the client model.
- **Three matching surfaces:** MCP tools, a CLI (`kb`/`exomem`), and a personal REST facade — all generated from the same operation registry.

### FAQ

**Which agents can use Exomem?**
Any MCP-capable client: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, custom agents, or scripts via the CLI/REST surfaces.

**Do my notes leave my machine?**
No. The vault stays plain markdown files you own. Search indexes are local SQLite sidecar files next to your vault. The lean install has no cloud dependency.

**Does it need a GPU?**
No. The lean install works with keyword/BM25 search out of the box (FTS5 ships inside Python's bundled SQLite). Optional extras add local embedding, CLIP, OCR, and ASR models — GPU accelerates them but is not required.

**How fast is search on a large vault?**
Measured on a 50,000-note corpus: sub-second hybrid search end-to-end, with the lexical lanes answering in milliseconds from the FTS5 index. Numbers and methodology: https://github.com/Artexis10/exomem/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md

## Q

**Tagline:** AI-powered knowledge infrastructure.

Q is a multi-tenant RAG platform that turns a creator or company's content library (YouTube, documents, PDFs) into a branded, searchable AI knowledge base — with citations back to the original source content.

- Hosted product at https://useq.ai
- Branded Q&A with custom domain per tenant
- 7-layer RAG pipeline for retrieval quality
- Status: Early access

### How It Works

1. **Ingest:** A creator connects their content library (YouTube channels, document uploads, PDFs). Q processes and indexes everything through its RAG pipeline.
2. **Brand:** Each tenant gets a branded Q&A interface on their own custom domain. Subscribers authenticate via Discord OAuth.
3. **Ask:** Subscribers ask questions against the creator's content. Answers are grounded in source material with citations linking back to the original video timestamp or document.

### Features

- **Multi-tenant isolation:** Each creator's content, branding, and subscribers are isolated.
- **Branded Q&A:** Custom domain, custom look — the creator's brand, not Q's.
- **7-layer RAG pipeline:** Retrieval tuned for semantic recall and precision across mixed content types.
- **Semantic search:** Across transcripts and documents, not just keyword match.
- **Citation-first answers:** Every answer points back to the source video or document.
- **Discord OAuth:** Subscriber authentication via Discord for community-native creators.
- **Creator dashboard:** Ingestion controls and subscriber/question analytics.

### Status

Early access. Contact the founder for access.

---

## Why Endstate Was Built

Written by Hugo Ander Kivi, April 2026.

The problem: every fresh Windows install requires manually remembering apps, hunting down installers, reinstalling one by one, and losing all settings and configurations. Existing tools don't solve the full problem — Ninite has a fixed app list and doesn't touch settings, winget is a package manager not a provisioning system, Chocolatey targets DevOps, Microsoft Store multi-app install is limited and install-only. None capture both apps and their settings as a single portable snapshot.

Endstate captures what's installed and how it's configured, then restores it. It's declarative — describe the desired end state, and the tool converges the machine toward it. Idempotent — run it twice, nothing breaks. The engine is a Go CLI (open source, Apache 2.0). The desktop app is Tauri (React + Rust). Setup is a folder in Documents — inspectable, copyable, backable up. No hidden databases, no cloud dependency, no account required.

Full article: https://substratesystems.io/endstate/why

---

## Guides

- [Exomem vs claude-mem](https://substratesystems.io/blog/exomem-vs-claude-mem): claude-mem captures and replays session activity from a local SQLite/Chroma store; Exomem stores curated conclusions as Markdown in a vault you own. Both are open source and agent-agnostic — the difference is where the data lives and who curates it.
- [How to transfer programs from one computer to another](https://substratesystems.io/blog/transfer-programs-to-another-computer): Why installed programs cannot be copied between Windows PCs, why the paid migration tools are structurally fragile, and what to do instead — capture what is installed plus its settings, then reinstall clean.
- [The complete guide to setting up a new Windows PC](https://substratesystems.io/blog/new-windows-pc-setup-guide): Reinstall your apps, bring your settings, handle the Store gap, and skip the paid migration tools.
- [How to restore Windows apps and settings after reinstalling Windows](https://substratesystems.io/blog/restore-windows-apps-and-settings-after-reinstall): Rebuild selected apps and supported settings from an Endstate profile captured before reinstalling Windows.
- [A free, open-source alternative to EaseUS Todo PCTrans, Zinstall, and Laplink PCmover](https://substratesystems.io/blog/free-open-source-pc-migration-alternative): Endstate compared to paid PC migration tools on price, method, and trust.
- [How to reinstall all your apps with winget (and what it misses)](https://substratesystems.io/blog/reinstall-all-apps-with-winget): Exactly how winget export/import works, plus the apps and settings it quietly leaves behind.
- [Why winget export skips your Microsoft Store apps](https://substratesystems.io/blog/winget-export-microsoft-store-apps): Why it happens, how to see what's missing, and how to capture everything.
- [Share your whole app setup as one file](https://substratesystems.io/blog/share-your-app-setup): Hand someone your exact app config — OBS scenes, MSI Afterburner profiles, your dev setup.
- [Governance as compression: contracts and skills for AI-augmented codebases](https://substratesystems.io/blog/governance-as-compression): The pattern that fixes AI-augmented development correction loops, with a controlled three-condition benchmark.

## Endstate Cloud

**Tagline:** Local by default. Cloud only by choice.

Endstate Cloud is the optional managed service: your encrypted setup history, ready on another Windows PC. It covers Endstate application lists and supported non-secret settings, encrypted on your machine before they leave, with keys you control — Endstate stores ciphertext and operational metadata only and cannot read or decrypt your data. Endstate Cloud protects the application list and supported non-secret settings captured by Endstate; it is not personal-file backup.

- €4/month or €40/year. Cancel any time.
- Keep protected versions without managing storage yourself.
- Restore your Endstate setup on another Windows PC.
- The self-hosting protocol stays open: anyone can run their own backup server, and the Endstate client supports an alternative server endpoint.
- Nothing about the local product depends on it. Capture, restore, profiles, manifests, verification, and backup to locations you control all work forever without a subscription.

## Support Endstate

Supporting Endstate is voluntary and separate from anything you buy. It is not a licence, a plan, or an upgrade: it unlocks no features, creates no entitlement, carries no recurring obligation, and nothing in the product checks whether you have contributed.

One-time contribution amounts: €89 (Patron) today, with €10 (Supporter) and €29 (Founding Supporter) planned. Larger contributions are arranged by email as a Custom Project Sponsor. Recognition on the supporters page and in the open-source repository is opt-in and consent-based.

- Supporters page: https://substratesystems.io/endstate/supporters

---

## Sponsor an Integration

Endstate already reinstalls applications through WinGet and Chocolatey. Integration sponsorship funds deeper migration support: safe settings capture and restore, version handling, package-identity edge cases, testing, and documentation.

- Ordinary Endstate development and community contributions continue regardless.
- Sponsorship buys priority, explicit scope, and verification — not influence over the rest of the roadmap.
- Public integrations become part of free, open-source Endstate under Apache 2.0.
- Private organisational and vendor integrations are available by quotation.
- A completed sponsorship does not imply lifetime maintenance; ongoing compatibility guarantees require a separate agreement.
- No public fixed price. Request a quote by email.

- Page: https://substratesystems.io/endstate/sponsor-an-integration

## Terms, Privacy & Refunds

**Terms:** The local Endstate product is free, on any number of machines, without an account. The engine is licensed under Apache 2.0. A Support Endstate contribution is a one-time voluntary payment, not a licence, and grants no additional features. Software provided "as is" without warranty.

**Privacy:** No data collection during normal use. No analytics, telemetry, or tracking in the local product. Scanning and saving is entirely offline. Endstate Cloud subscriptions and Support Endstate contributions are processed by Paddle. App installation downloads via winget directly from publishers — Substrate is not involved.

**Refunds:** Endstate Cloud subscriptions: full refund within 14 days of purchase or renewal, no questions asked (no mid-period pro-rating — cancel anytime and keep access until period end). Support Endstate contributions: refundable within 30 days of purchase, no questions asked. Email founder@substratesystems.io with your order number.

**Entity:** Substrate Systems OÜ, Estonia.
**Contact:** founder@substratesystems.io
